_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja ForeDeck/Poklad Dziobowy (107 terminow, ~22 mikroscen) - pierwsza lokacja gry (wejscie na lodz podwodna) oraz jej powtorna wersja po wyplynieciu na powierzchnie pod koniec gry (Resurface_*). Zawiera zagadkowa scene MermaidVoice ze zniekstalconym glosem, mechanike boi/zielonego swiatla, oraz przemalowana nazwe lodzi Seafoam->Mortuga.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci.
_meta.uwagi_tlumaczeniowe: Dwie gry slowne bez bezposredniego odpowiednika w polskim zaadaptowane funkcjonalnie: (1) 'buoy' pronunciation joke (Resurface_buoy ds11-14) - PO PRZEGLADZIE LQA (2026-07-25, v38): spor o wymowe 'bo-j'/'bu-i'; (2) 'bay vs gulf' geografia (rock ds10-12) - PO PRZEGLADZIE LQA: 'zwykla zatoka vs wielka zatoka'; (3) 'poop deck' pun (aft ds2-3) - PO PRZEGLADZIE LQA: 'pokladem zadnim' (odtwarza efekt 'poprawny termin brzmi smiesznie/niezrecznie'). Pelna analiza i historia zmian: Docs/LQA_HUMOR_WORDPLAY_REVIEW.md.

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_CantEscape/Se.en: Let's take a look around first.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_CantEscape/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_MermaidVoice/.en: I didn't understand what you said.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_MermaidVoice/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_aft.en: Hey - we forgot to go check it out!
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_aft.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_aft.en: We didn't forget - it was [i]underwater[/i] until about two minutes ago.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_aft.pl: Nie zapomnieliśmy - było [i]pod wodą[/i] jeszcze jakieś dwie minuty temu.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_aft.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_bg.en: It's the fore deck. Looks about the same as before.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_bg.pl: To Pokład Dziobowy. Wygląda mniej więcej tak samo jak wcześniej.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_bg.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_bg.en: What are we supposed to do now??
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_bg.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_bg.en: It's the fore deck. Looks about the same as before.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_bg.pl: To Pokład Dziobowy. Wygląda mniej więcej tak samo jak wcześniej.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_bg.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_boa.en: I've been in some [i]pretty shabby[/i] rowing boats in my time...
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_boa.pl: Bywałem w swoim czasie w niektórych [i]całkiem nędznych[/i] łódkach wiosłowych...
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_boa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_buo.pl: Hej, koleżko. Dawno się nie widzieliśmy.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_buo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_buo.pl: Tak w ogóle to się czyta [i]'bo-j'.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_buo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_buo.pl: [i]Nie zgadzam się[/i], że się nie zgadzamy!
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_buo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.en: This makes a little more sense now.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.pl: Teraz to ma trochę więcej sensu.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.en: But who painted the big [i]Mortuga[/i] name on there?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.pl: Ale kto namalował tam ten wielki napis [i]Mortuga[/i]?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.en: You don't think Mortuga would've done it himself?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.pl: Nie sądzisz, że Mortuga zrobiłby to sam?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.en: Then I guess it was the guy who rebuilt the submarine.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.pl: W takim razie chyba zrobił to facet, który przebudował łódź podwodną.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.en: Drummond? I think his name was? The shipyard guy.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.pl: Drummond? Chyba tak się nazywał? Facet ze stoczni.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_nam.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.en: I really don't appreciate being kicked out - she didn't even pay us!
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.pl: Naprawdę nie podoba mi się to wyrzucanie nas - nawet nam nie zapłaciła!
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.en: We can worry about that later-
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.en: I don't know if you've noticed, but we're currently [i]stranded[/i] out here.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.pl: Nie wiem, czy zauważyłeś, ale jesteśmy obecnie [i]uwięzieni[/i] tutaj.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.en: Wait - so how is Sinthia expecting us to leave the submarine?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.pl: Czekaj - to jak Sinthia spodziewa się, że opuścimy łódź podwodną?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sal.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.en: It's sunset. It'll be dark soon.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.en: We were down there [i]all day[/i] and I barely felt it.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.pl: Byliśmy tam na dole [i]cały dzień[/i], a ledwie to poczułam.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.en: ...it's hard to keep track of time when you're down there.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.pl: ...trudno śledzić upływ czasu, kiedy jest się tam na dole.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.en: It's sunset. It'll be dark soon.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_Resurface_sky.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_aft/Section d.en: I can see the other end of the submarine.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_aft/Section d.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_aft/Section d.en: Presumably that's the aft deck. Also known as the poop deck.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_aft/Section d.pl: Przypuszczalnie to Pokład Rufowy. Zwany też... pokładem zadnim.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_aft/Section d.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_aft/Section d.en: There's another deck back there... that one looks like it's made of wood, though.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_aft/Section d.pl: Jest tam z tyłu jeszcze jeden pokład... ten wygląda jednak, jakby był zrobiony z drewna.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_aft/Section d.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.en: So, this is the Mortuga Submarine?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.pl: Więc to jest Łódź Podwodna Mortugi?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.en: According to the case file, yeah.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.en:
He [h]was[/h] the Captain.
Now he's the murder victim.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.en: Okay, so where's the new captain?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.pl: Okej, więc gdzie jest nowy kapitan?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_bg/Section ds.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.en: This is where the green light was coming from...
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.en: I noticed it started to fade as soon as we stepped onto the deck.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.pl: Zauważyłam, że zaczęło gasnąć, gdy tylko weszliśmy na pokład.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.en: So it's a buoy that doubles as a lighthouse?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.pl: Więc to boja, która pełni też funkcję latarni morskiej?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.en: A lighthouse warns you to stay away, but this thing lured us in.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.pl: Latarnia ostrzega, żeby trzymać się z daleka, ale ta rzecz nas przywabiła.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_buoy 2/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_chain/Section.en: There's a chain connecting the buoy to the door.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_chain/Section.pl: Jest łańcuch łączący boję z drzwiami.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_chain/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_chain/Section.en: So when the fore deck is underwater, the buoy floats up above it?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_chain/Section.pl: Więc kiedy Pokład Dziobowy jest pod wodą, boja unosi się nad nim?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_chain/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_chain/Section.en: That explains how we saw the green light before the submarine actually surfaced.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_chain/Section.pl: To wyjaśnia, jak zobaczyliśmy zielone światło, zanim łódź podwodna faktycznie wypłynęła na powierzchnię.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_chain/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_entrance/Sect.en: Somebody must've opened it after the submarine surfaced.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_entrance/Sect.pl: Ktoś musiał je otworzyć, gdy łódź wypłynęła na powierzchnię.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_entrance/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_names/Section.en: Looks like it initially said [i]Seafoam[/i], but that got crossed out and now it says [i]Mortuga[/i].
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_names/Section.pl: Wygląda na to, że pierwotnie było napisane [i]Seafoam[/i], ale zostało przekreślone i teraz jest napisane [i]Mortuga[/i].
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_names/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_names/Section.en: Take another look at the case file.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_names/Section.pl: Spójrz jeszcze raz na akta sprawy.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_names/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_names/Section.en: I'm getting mutiny vibes from this, I don't know about you.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_names/Section.pl: Czuję w tym klimat buntu na pokładzie, nie wiem jak ty.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_names/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_puddle/Sectio.en: Those are some big puddles, considering it's only slightly raining.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_puddle/Sectio.pl: To są całkiem duże kałuże, jak na to, że pada tylko lekki deszcz.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_puddle/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_puddle/Sectio.en: Yes. However, five minutes ago, the fore deck was underwater.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_puddle/Sectio.pl: Tak. Jednakże pięć minut temu Pokład Dziobowy był pod wodą.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_puddle/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_rock/Section.en: The coastal rocks that curve around the bay of Silkwirm-on-Sea.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_rock/Section.pl: Nadbrzeżne skały, które okalają zatokę Silkwirm-on-Sea.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_rock/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_rock/Section.en: Wait - is it a bay or a gulf?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_rock/Section.pl: Czekaj - to zwykła zatoka czy wielka zatoka?
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_rock/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_rock/Section.en: A gulf would be deeper. More enclosed.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_rock/Section.pl: Wielka zatoka byłaby cóż... głębsza. Bardziej zamknięta.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_rock/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sail/Section.en: It's the bit that... sticks out of the top of the submarine.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sail/Section.pl: To ta część, która... wystaje z góry łodzi podwodnej.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sail/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sail/Section.en: It's called the sail - or sometimes the [i]fairwater.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sail/Section.pl: Nazywa się to kiosk - albo czasem [i]nadbudówka dziobowa.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sail/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sky/Section d.en: It's dawn. Looks like the sun is trying to come out.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sky/Section d.pl: Jest świt. Wygląda na to, że słońce próbuje wyjść.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sky/Section d.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sky/Section d.en: It needn't have bothered. We're not going to be around to see it.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sky/Section d.pl: Nie musiało się trudzić. I tak nie będzie nas tu, żeby to zobaczyć.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sky/Section d.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sky/Section d.en: Because we're going inside the submarine.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sky/Section d.pl: Bo wchodzimy do środka łodzi podwodnej.
Examine/Exam_Area_ForeDeck_sky/Section d.speaker: Sally
